summary: Charlottesville, Virginia resident, technology consultant with 20 years of experience, specializes in software development and team management, strong advocate for modeling in software design, has a family with children, values personal freedom and innovation over traditional success metrics, interested in philosophy and its application to technology, enjoys outdoor activities, particularly hiking, has a background in various programming languages including C++, Java, and OCaml, critical of political correctness and advocates for open discussions on controversial topics, believes in the importance of personal responsibility and self-reliance, has experienced significant life challenges including loss of possessions and a difficult divorce, values practical experience over formal education, and has a contrarian view on societal norms and expectations.
